Plex needs atlas (it runs as a Docker container there) and tank (its library on tank/media and appdata on tank/appdata). The titan dependency is superseded history and is ignored.
Directly, the Ollama endpoint on titan stops working (it needs titan awake). Second hop, the wiki search service degrades: new wiki pages are not embedded, but keyword search still works.
The nightly rclone backup needs atlas (it runs there), tank (it reads the 05:45 tank snapshot) and gate (for internet access to upload).
hermes needs atlas (the VM runs on atlas and stops when atlas stops) and tank (its vdisk is on tank/domains and it cannot boot without tank).

Syncing of the notes folder to pebble stops. Syncthing runs as a container on atlas, so it stops directly; it also depends on Tailscale, which runs on atlas and carries the Syncthing-to-pebble traffic.

Directly: reverse-proxy (outside access to Plex and wiki search), tailscale (internet and remote access), rclone-backup (cloud upload), atlas Unraid notification email, and aria (its network address from gate). Second hop: pebble (remote access to hermes and Plex) and syncthing (notes sync to pebble) via tailscale.

Directly, the wiki search service needs hermes. Indirectly, hermes needs atlas and tank (it runs on atlas with its vdisk on tank). The titan Ollama endpoint is only needed for embeddings of new pages, so keyword search does not depend on it.

If atlas shuts down, the pool tank stops, and the hosted items stop with it: the hermes VM, plex, the reverse-proxy, syncthing, the tailscale plugin (remote access and exit node) and the nightly rclone-backup. Second hop: the wiki-search service on hermes also stops.

Directly, plex (library and appdata), hermes (its vdisk is on tank/domains), syncthing (notes folder) and rclone-backup (snapshot source) stop. Through another host, wiki-search stops via hermes, and notes sync to pebble stops via syncthing.

If hermes is down, the wiki search service (qmd) stops with it and the nightly index rebuild goes stale. The wiki repo at /srv/wiki is also unavailable there, and pebble loses its remote path to hermes.
